overall_notes: The paper is primarily about evaluating LLMs' ability to follow complex instructions with multiple constraints. CFBench is their introduced benchmark. The evaluation uses GPT-4o as the main judge model with custom metrics (CSR, ISR, PSR). Human evaluation was conducted for quality validation of the benchmark itself and to validate the automatic metrics. The extraction was generally good but needed normalization and some refinement of model lists and evaluation criteria.
